cards.t: Keyboard Cat starts playing people off
cards.fact: A 1980s home video of a cat in a blue shirt playing a keyboard became the internet's way of ending a fail.
h: Keyboard Cat played people off in the early days of YouTube memes.
Keyboard Cat took off the same year Angry Birds came out.
Keyboard Cat
Webkinz plush toys came with an online world in YouTube's early days.
Webkinz launched the same year Leeroy Jenkins went viral.
Webkinz

cards.t: The Fellowship of the Ring hits cinemas
h: The first Lord of the Rings film came out just after the dot com bubble burst.
The first Lord of the Rings film came out the same year as the first Harry Potter film.
The Fellowship of the Ring
Chernobyl happened in the final years of the Cold War, inside the Soviet Union.
Chernobyl happened the same year the Space Shuttle Challenger broke apart.
The Chernobyl disaster

cards.fact: Sliced bread is younger than American women's right to vote. It only went on sale in 1928.
h: Sliced bread arrived at the tail end of the Roaring Twenties.
Sliced bread went on sale the same year penicillin was discovered.
Sliced bread

cards.t: American women win the right to vote
h: American women won the vote at the start of the Roaring Twenties.
American women won the vote two years after World War I ended.
Votes for American women

cards.t: Work begins on the Leaning Tower of Pisa
h: Work on the Leaning Tower began in the High Middle Ages.
Work on Pisa's tower began about 40 years before Magna Carta.
The Leaning Tower
Caesar was killed in the final years of the Roman Republic, before Rome had emperors.
Rome had its first emperor, Augustus, within 20 years of Caesar's assassination.
Caesar's assassination
